errorCodes.meaning: The network defines no role named `role`.

BroadcastRecord.description: A broadcast as this network sent or relayed it.

actor.description: For a sent message, the administrator that sent it.

direction.description: Whether this network sent it or received it to relay.

from.description: For a received message, the network that delivered it.

role.description: The role it was addressed to.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

DeliveryStatus.description: What happened to one delivery. `queued` will be retried.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

network.description: Whether the group is a network group, which relays further.

relayed.description: The receipts the network group's own relay returned.

Response.description: The broadcast as recorded, with each group's receipt as it stands when the network answers. Queued deliveries are retried from the outbox and update the record later.
Response.title: VTN Broadcasts — Send — response payload

schema.description: An administrator's message for every group registered for a role. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

class.description: What kind of message it is, for the receiving group to sort on: `notice` (the default), `request-for-action`, `room-invite`, or another the network's framework names.

replyTo.description: Where replies go, such as a URL or DID for a network data room, so that a broadcast never becomes reply-all.

role.description: The role to address: delivered to every current member's group registered for it.
